technical.summary: Mixed bullish technicals with short-term momentum (EMA cross, Supertrend) offset by weak trend strength, bearish MACD, and price below 200-SMA; moderate confluence but elevated pullback risk.

fundamental.summary: DOC shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying engagement, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 35 days present near-term volatility risk.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional activity with mixed signals (sale then purchase 6 weeks prior); market fear (43 score) presents contrarian opportunity but lack of recent news and insider conviction limits conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (223.8) indicates extreme market stress, real estate sector faces credit tightening and demand destruction in recessionary environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 9/21 golden cross, Supertrend bullish, and Ichimoku above cloud provide short-term momentum confluence with price near support (20.1572), offering a contrarian entry in fear-zone conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 223.8, credit spread stress), price below 200-SMA, bearish MACD, weak ADX trend strength (11.83), zero fundamental conviction, and earnings volatility in 35 days create unacceptable risk-reward despite technical signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows short-term momentum (EMA cross, Supertrend bullish) at support with contrarian fear-zone opportunity; however, macro environment and fundamental weakness do not justify new exposure.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (223.8), and earnings volatility in 35 days create severe downside risk that outweighs technical confluence; real estate sector faces recession headwinds.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
